page.layout: One printed page, single column of dictionary entries mixing Hebrew/Aramaic/Syriac script with Latin glosses; running head at top with page number at top right. No margin notes or footnotes.

main_text.l: אכליתא, אכליות Ch. Clamor, rugitus, vociferatio.
ܦܠܛܘܪܐ Syr. Accusator, calumniator. Sic synec-
dochicè vocatur Diabolus. Plur. ܩܛܪܝܢ.
ܦܠܛܘܝܐ Syr. Delatio, accusatio, ad Rom.1.30.
Sed Johan. 18.29. scribitur ut duæ distinctæ voces
ܦܠܛܘܐ, quod apparet ex ל finali.
אוכלוםא, אוכלום Ch. ܐܟܠܘܣܐ Syr. Populus, Coetus,
turba, congregatio. Græc. ὄχλος. Act. 21.24. scri-
bitur ܐܟܠܘܣܐ. Plur. אוכלוסין.
* אכם Ch. Nigrum, Atrum esse.
אכמא, אכם Niger, Atratus, Pullatus. Fœmin. אכמתא
Nigra, Levit.11.19. in Jon.
אוכמא, אוכם Ch. & Syr. Idem. חמרא אוכמא Vinum ni-
grum, id est, rubrum, Esth.1.9. in Targ.sec. Plural.
אוכמין. Fœm. אוכמתא. Sic Syr. Matth.5.36.
אוכמתא Ch. Nigredo, Thren.4.8.
אוכמות Idem, יומי אוכמות עער הבלו Dies nigredinis cri-
nium, id est, juventutis, vanitas, Eccl.11.10.
אכסדרא Ch. Procæton, Prætorium, Atrium,
Græcum est ἐξέδρα. Hinc forte numero plurali le-
gendum אכסנדריא pro אכסנדריא Esth. 7. 10. in Tar-
gum sec.
אכסן Ch. ܐܟܣܢܐ Syr. Hospes, peregrinus. Ex Græco
ξένος. Plur.Chald. אכסנין, אכסניא: Syr. ܐܟܣܢܐ.
ܐܟܣܢܐ Amans hospites, φιλόξενος,
Hospitalis. Vide quoque כסן.
אכף

page.notes: Hebrew, Aramaic and Syriac words are rendered approximately; the Syriac and Greek glyphs in several entries are not reliably legible and may differ from the printed forms. Entries are transcribed as read.
